name: Soyuz TM-24
about: Soyuz TM-24 (1996-047A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STM), launched 1996 Aug 17. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1996 Sep 17), held fixed
docked to S16609; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
